name: Beginner Strumming Pattern 1
instructions: Now add yesterday's pattern to an actual chord (D or one of your easy 2-finger chords) and strum it slowly.
Use a metronome or the video's beat as your guide -- rhythm accuracy matters more than speed at this stage.
If the pattern falls apart when you add a chord, go back to muting the strings and rebuild the motion.
Watch today's video for a full walkthrough of this pattern.
